info.title: Driver shift diary
info.description:
A driver's shift diary: shifts, the trips inside them, and the day's take-home.

**Access.** Log in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`: it sets an HttpOnly `session` cookie that
the browser then sends by itself. Every other endpoint needs it (401 otherwise). Drivers see
their own diary; the admin manages drivers and corrects their entries.

**Errors.** Every 4xx/5xx has the body `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields", "ctx"}}`.
`code` is stable (see the responses of each endpoint); a 422 lists all invalid fields at once.

**Ids** are UUIDs. A trip's id is generated by the client, so a retried request is not stored
twice. **Times** carry the UTC offset they were recorded in and come back the same way.
**Money** is in whole tenge (KZT).

get.description: Used by the Docker healthcheck. No session needed.

post.description:
Sets the HttpOnly `session` cookie (30 days) and returns the profile. A wrong password
and an unknown email get the same answer; after 5 failures an email waits 15 minutes
(**429 too_many_attempts** with Retry-After).

post.summary: Start a shift, or enter a past one
post.description:
An empty body starts a shift now. With `started_at` only, a shift starts then; with
`ended_at` too, a finished past shift is entered.

At most 24 hours long, at most 7 days back, never in the future. One open shift at a
time (**409 shift_already_open**); shifts never overlap (**409 shift_overlap**).

post.description:
Adds a trip to one of the driver's shifts, inside its start and end.

Idempotent by `id`: a retried request returns **200** with the stored trip. The same `id`
with different data is **409 trip_conflict**; a time that overlaps another trip is
**409 trip_overlap**. With a commission percent set by the admin, the server computes
`commission_amount`. A shift that ended more than 7 days ago no longer takes trips.
